content.short: Herodotus.dev provides storage-proof technology enabling crossdomain data access between Ethereum layers via an API.
content.description: Herodotus.dev delivers storage-proof technology through a simple API, making cross-domain data across Ethereum layers easy to access. Developers can retrieve historical metrics such as Gas spent, Volume Traded, and Balances Held, among others. The platform also enables synchronous access to the state of other L1s and L2s by validating state proofs. This approach hides the complexity of storage proofs while providing reliable, verifiable data for multi-chain applications and analytics.
